message.content:
🎉 **Happy 40th Birthday, Walid!** 🎉

Big news, friends! Our wonderful Walid is turning the big 4-0, and we're throwing him a party!

📅 **When:** This Saturday, 2 PM
📍 **Where:** The Park Pavilion
👋 **Who:** EVERYONE is welcome!

Come celebrate with good food, great company, and plenty of laughs. Bring your best birthday wishes, your smiles, and maybe your singing voice. Rumor has it the guest of honor loves a good karaoke session! 🎤😄

Let's make Walid's milestone birthday one to remember. See you there! 🎂🎈

#HappyBirthdayWalid #40andFabulous
